from tmp_all t, tmp_stock_code t1 where t.rank_ <= 10 * 2 and (t.`date` = '99999-0.00' or t.`date` not like '99999%') and t.stockCode = t1.stockCode union select t.`date`, t.stockCode, t.`last`, t.ratioB, t.clac_expma_5, t.clac_expma_10, t.chg , rank() over (partition by stockCode order by rank_ ) rank_2 from tmp_all t, tmp_stock_code t1 where t.rank_ <= 10 * 2 and (t.`date` = '99999-0.01' or t.`date` not like '99999%') and t.stockCode = t1.stockCode union select t.`date`, t.stockCode, t.`last`, t.ratioB, t.clac_expma_5, t.clac_expma_10, t.chg , rank() over (partition by stockCode order by rank_ ) rank_2 from tmp_all t, tmp_stock_code t1 where t.rank_ <= 10 * 2 and (t.`date` = '99999-0.02' or t.`date` not like '99999%') and t.stockCode = t1.stockCode union select t.`date`, t.stockCode, t.`last`, t.ratioB, t.clac_expma_5, t.clac_expma_10, t.chg , rank() over (partition by stockCode order by rank_ ) rank_2 from tmp_all t, tmp_stock_code t1 where t.rank_ <= 10 * 2 and (t.`date` = '99999-0.03' or t.`date` not like '99999%') and t.stockCode = t1.stockCode ) , tmp_all_but_99999 as ( select t.`date`, t.stockCode, t.`last`, t.ratioB, t.clac_expma_5, t.clac_expma_10, t.chg , rank() over (partition by stockCode order by rank_ ) rank_2 from tmp_all t, tmp_stock_code t1 where t.rank_ <= 10 * 2 and t.stockCode = t1.stockCode ) , tmp_consider_99999 as ( select * from tmp_all_but_99999 where rank_2 <= 10 union (select * from tmp_rank_99999 where `date` like '99999%' and rank_2 <= 10 ) ) select distinct t1.date , concat(t3.stockCode, '-', t3.stockName, '-', case when t1.date like '99999%' then t1.date else replace(t1.date, '-', '') end, '-', t1.rank_2, '/10' ) stockCode , concat(round(t1.last, 3), '\n(', case when t1.date like '99999%' then replace(replace(t1.date, '0.0', ''), '99999', '') else t1.chg end, ')') last, concat(round(t1.clac_expma_5, 3), '\n', round(t1.clac_expma_10, 3)) ratioB from tmp_consider_99999 t1, t_etf t3 where t1.stockCode = concat(t3.stockType , '.', t3.stockCode ) order by 1 desc, 2

with tmp_all as ( select ten.* -- ten.`date` , ten.stockCode , ten.`last`, -- , rank() over (partition by ten.stockCode order by clac_expma_10/clac_expma_5 desc) rank_, clac_expma_10/clac_expma_5 ratioB, clac_expma_5, clac_expma_10 from t_etf_raw ten where ten.`date` >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 365+60 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') ) , tmp_calc_days as ( select distinct t1.date end_date , case when t1.`date` like '9999%' then DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 365 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') else DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(t1.date, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 365 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') end start_date from tmp_all t1 where t1.date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') ) select t1.date , concat(t3.stockCode, '-', t3.stockName, '-', case when t1.date like '99999%' then t1.date else replace(t1.date, '-', '') end, '-', t1.rank_, '/10' ) stockCode , concat(round(t1.last, 3), '\n(', case when t1.date like '99999%' then replace(replace(t1.date, '0.0', ''), '99999', '') else t1.chg end, ')') last, concat(round(t1.clac_expma_5, 3), '\n', round(t1.clac_expma_10, 3)) ratioB from ( select t1.end_date, t2.`date` , t2.stockCode , t2.`last`, t2.chg , rank() over (partition by end_date, stockCode order by clac_expma_10/clac_expma_5 desc) rank_ -- , count(1) over (partition by end_date, stockCode) count_ , clac_expma_10/clac_expma_5 ratioB, clac_expma_5, clac_expma_10 from tmp_calc_days t1, tmp_all t2 where t2.`date` BETWEEN t1.start_date and t1.end_date union select t1.end_date, t2.`date` , t2.stockCode , t2.`last`, t2.chg , rank() over (partition by end_date, stockCode order by clac_expma_10/clac_expma_5 desc) rank_ -- , count(1) over (partition by end_date, stockCode) count_ , clac_expma_10/clac_expma_5 ratioB, clac_expma_5, clac_expma_10 from tmp_calc_days t1, tmp_all t2 where t2.`date` BETWEEN t1.start_date and t1.end_date and ( t2.`date` = t1.end_date or t2.`date` not like '9999%' ) ) t1, t_etf t3 where t1.rank_ <= 10 and t1.end_date = t1.`date` and t1.stockCode = concat(t3.stockType , '.', t3.stockCode ) order by 1 desc, 2

select concat(t3.stockCode, '-', t3.stockName) stockCode, t1.date, concat(round(t1.last, 3), '
(', t1.chg, ')') last , case when t1.end_buy_date = 1 then concat('慎重
', round(t1.to_buy, 3)) else concat('历史
', round(t1.to_buy, 3)) end ratioB from ( select t.`date` , t.stockCode , t.chg, t.to_buy, t.volume, t.`open` , t.`last`, t.high , t.low , DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(t.`date`, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 15 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), '%Y-%m-%d') end_buy_date from ( select t.`date` , t.stockCode , t.chg , round(t.`last`/(1+t.chg*0.01)*(1+t.chg*0.01*0.618), 3) to_buy , t.volume , least(lead(t.volume) over (partition by t.stockCode order by `date` desc) , lead(t.volume, 2) over (partition by t.stockCode order by `date` desc)) pre_volume , t.`open` , t.`last`, t.high , t.low -- , lag(t.`date`, 2) over (partition by t.stockCode order by `date` desc) date_exists -- , least(lag(t.low , 1) over (partition by t.stockCode order by `date` desc) -- , lag(t.low , 2) over (partition by t.stockCode order by `date` desc)) to_buy -- T~T+2，共3个交易日的 low，T+3时B -- , lag(t.volume, 1) over (partition by t.stockCode order by `date` desc) vol_next_1 -- , lag(t.chg, 1) over (partition by t.stockCode order by `date` desc) chg_next_1 -- , lag(t.volume, 2) over (partition by t.stockCode order by `date` desc) vol_next_2 -- , lag(t.chg, 2) over (partition by t.stockCode order by `date` desc) chg_next_2 from t_etf_raw t where t.`date` > DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(SYSDATE(), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL -1 YEAR), '%Y-%m-%d') -- and t.stockCode like '%600803' ) t where t.volume >= 2 * pre_volume and t.chg >= 2 and t.high / t.`last` < 1.01 and t.`open` / t.low < 1.01 -- and date_exists is not null -- and (chg_next_1 >= 0 or (chg_next_1 < 0 and vol_next_1 <= volume*0.618)) -- and (chg_next_2 >= 0 or (chg_next_2 < 0 and vol_next_2 <= volume*0.618)) ) t1, t_etf t3 where t1.stockCode = concat(t3.stockType , '.', t3.stockCode ) order by 2 desc

select concat(t3.stockCode, '-', t3.stockName) stockCode, t1.date, concat(round(t1.last, 3), '\n(', t1.chg, ')') last , concat(round(clac_expma_5, 3), '\n', round(clac_expma_10, 3)) ratioB from ( select t.*, rank() over (partition by t.stockCode order by t.date desc) rank_ from t_etf_raw t where t.`date` > '2025-01-01' ) t1, t_etf t3 where t1.stockCode = concat(t3.stockType , '.', t3.stockCode ) and t1.rank_ = 1 order by 2, 1

with tmp_etf as ( select rank() over (partition by tene.stockCode order by tene.volume) - 1 rank_min , rank() over (partition by tene.stockCode order by tene.volume desc) - 1 rank_max , tene.*, te.stockName from t_etf_raw tene, t_etf te where tene .stockCode = concat(te.stockType, '.', te.stockCode ) -- and tene.date = '2026-02-13' -- and tene.stockCode = '0.159206' and `date` > DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -90 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') and `date` < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d') ) , tmp_ans as ( select te.date , te.stockCode , te.`last` , temin.`last` last_min , round(te.`last`/temin.`last`*100) - 100 win_chg , round(te.volume/temin.volume, 0) vol_multi , te.chg , temin.date date_min , temin.volume vol_min , temin.stockCode sc_min , temin.stockName sn_min from tmp_etf te , (select stockCode, stockName, max(`date`) date, max(volume) volume, max(`last`) last from tmp_etf where rank_min <= 3 and chg < 9 and chg > -9 group by stockCode, stockName) temin where te.volume > temin.volume * 5 -- and te.volume < temin.volume * 50 and trim(te.stockCode) = trim(temin.stockCode) and te.`date` > temin.`date` ) select concat(ta.stockCode, '
', t3.stockName) stockCode , concat(ta.date, '
', ta.date_min) date , concat(ta.last, '
', ta.last_min) last , concat('p-chg:', ta.win_chg, '
p-vol:', ta.vol_multi) ratioB from tmp_ans ta, t_etf t3 where ta.stockCode = concat(t3.stockType , '.', t3.stockCode) order by ta.date desc, t3.stockName

with tmp_date_1 as ( select distinct date from t_index_raw t where t.stockCode = '1.000001' order by 1 desc limit 1 ) , tmp_date_2 as ( select distinct date from t_index_raw t where t.stockCode = '1.000001' order by 1 desc limit 1 offset 1 ) , tmp_rank_1 as ( select tene.`date` , tene.chg , tene.volume , rank() over (partition by tene.date order by tene.chg desc, tene.stockCode ) chg_rank , tene.stockCode , t3.stockName from t_etf_raw tene , t_etf t3, tmp_date_1 t5 where 1 = 1 and tene.`date` = t5.`date` and tene.stockCode = concat(t3.stockType , '.', t3.stockCode ) order by chg_rank, 1 desc ) , tmp_rank_2 as ( select tene.`date` , tene.chg , tene.volume , rank() over (partition by tene.date order by tene.chg desc, tene.stockCode ) chg_rank , tene.stockCode , t3.stockName from t_etf_raw tene , t_etf t3, tmp_date_2 t5 where 1 = 1 and tene.`date` = t5.`date` and tene.stockCode = concat(t3.stockType , '.', t3.stockCode ) order by chg_rank, 1 desc ) select concat(t11.stockCode, '-', t11.stockName) stockCode , t11.`date` date , concat(t11.chg, '-', t11.chg_rank) last , concat(case when t11.chg_rank <= 3 -- 1、当天前三 and t11.chg > 2 -- 2、当天chg>2% and t11.volume BETWEEN t22.volume * 1.25 and t22.volume * 2 -- 3、相较于前一天，成交量放量25%~100% and t22.chg < 2 -- 4、前一天的chg<2% and t22.chg_rank > 3 -- 5、前一天不在前三； then '*got-' else '' end, 'next-vol: ', round(t11.volume * 1.25/10000), 'W ~ ', round(t11.volume * 2/10000), 'W') ratioB from tmp_rank_1 t11, tmp_rank_2 t22 where t11.stockCode = t22.stockCode order by t11.chg_rank

with tmp_res as ( select tene.`date` , lag(tene.date, 1) over (partition by tene.stockCode order by tene.`date` ) date_pre_1 , tene.stockCode , tene.chg , tene.`last` , round(tene.volume/lag(tene.`volume`, 1) over (partition by tene.stockCode order by tene.`date` ) *100, 1) - 100 vol_ratio_1 , lead(tene.`chg`, 1) over (partition by tene.stockCode order by tene.`date` ) chg_next_1 , lead(tene.`chg`, 2) over (partition by tene.stockCode order by tene.`date` ) chg_next_2 , rank() over (partition by tene.date order by tene.chg desc, tene.stockCode ) chg_rank from t_etf_raw tene where date > DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE() , INTERVAL -60 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') ) , tmp_target_res as ( select t1.* , GREATEST(chg_next_1, chg_next_1+chg_next_2) great from tmp_res t1 where 1 = 1 and t1.chg_rank <= 3 -- 1、当天前三 and t1.chg > 2 -- 2、当天chg>2% and t1.vol_ratio_1 between 25 and 100 -- 3、相较于前一天，成交量放量25%~100%； and not exists( select 1 from tmp_res t2 where t2.chg < 2 -- 4、前一天的chg<2% and t2.chg_rank <= 3 -- 5、前一天不在前三； and t1.date_pre_1 = t2.`date` and t1.stockCode = t2.stockCode ) ) select concat(t11.stockCode, '-', te.stockName) stockCode , date , concat('chg=', t11.chg) last , concat('后2日, great=' , case when round(great, 1) < 0 then '----' else '' end , round(great, 1), '%' ) ratioB from tmp_target_res t11, t_etf te where 1 = 1 and t11.stockCode = te.fullStockCode order by 2 desc, 1
